atoms.text: Use tabs for indentation in Python files; the project formatter is configured for tabs and CI rejects spaces.
Chose SQLite over a client-server database for storage because the tool is local-first and must run with no daemon to install.
Run database migrations before switching traffic to the new release; deploying code first caused a schema mismatch outage.
Retry requests that return HTTP 429 with exponential backoff and jitter instead of a fixed sleep.
Tests must be hermetic: no network access and no writes outside the temporary directory.
API keys are rotated every ninety days and stored in the secret manager, never committed to the repository.
Never force-push to the shared main branch; rebase a personal branch and open a merge request instead.
Write commit messages in the imperative mood with a short summary line under seventy-two characters.
A missing index on the events timestamp column made the dashboard query take several seconds; add an index before paginating.
Structured JSON logging is the standard; every log line carries a request identifier so traces can be correlated.
Dark theme is the default for the dashboard; respect the operating system color scheme when the user has not chosen one.
Writing from two processes to one SQLite file raised database is locked errors; enable WAL mode and set a busy timeout.
Releases follow semantic versioning and each tag is cut from main only after the full test suite passes.
Nightly backups are written to a separate disk and the newest seven copies are kept; older copies are pruned automatically.
Keep merge requests small, under four hundred changed lines, so a reviewer can finish within one sitting.
Read configuration from environment variables with documented defaults; hardcoded paths broke the container build.
